output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order
FROM marts.dim_customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND LOWER(TRIM(o.status)) = 'completed'
)
output.explanation: Counts customers in marts.dim_customers with no order in marts.fct_orders whose status is 'completed'. A NOT EXISTS anti-join is used so customers with only non-completed orders (or no orders at all) are included. The status comparison is case- and whitespace-insensitive because I did not check the distinct status values. I filtered on status rather than is_revenue because the question specifically asks about completed orders. I did not run the query, so the status literal should be verified against the actual values in fct_orders.
